title: Board of Governors closed for Veterans Day (observed) while the NYSE, the OCC and the Reserve Banks stay open — the second and last board-only-dark date in the Fed's published window
source: EST: federalreserve.gov/aboutthefed/k8.htm, 'K.8 - Holidays Observed by the Federal Reserve System 2026-2030', fetched direct 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 82,205 bytes, stamp 'Last Update: July 8, 2026') by the fed-board-closure-2027-12-31 initial research. The page's first footnote names this exact date without inference: 'Saturday - the Federal Reserve Banks are open, but the Board of Governors is closed on July 3, 2026, June 18, 2027, December 24, 2027, December 31, 2027, and November 10, 2028.' Its 2028 table column reads Veterans Day 'November 11*', the asterisk being that footnote, and 2028-11-11 is a Saturday (computed, not assumed). The market side is the opposite and is also primary-sourced: nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars, fetched direct the same session (HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes), states 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028' and its ten-row 2028 column carries NO Veterans Day row at all — the exchange does not observe the holiday in any year. optionseducation.org/api/expirationcalendar (HTTP 200, 34,871 bytes) does not reach 2028 and was not used for this date. Filed estimate on the same two counts as its sibling fed-board-closure-2027-12-31: this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep, and the confirmed-prefix taxonomy has no member for an agency's own internal holiday schedule as distinct from a market calendar. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED by the fed-board-closure-2027-12-31 initial research (2026-09-09), which needed the full board-only-dark census to state its own uniqueness claim honestly and found this second member of it. THE CLASS, DEFINED MECHANICALLY: the Board of Governors dark while the Reserve Banks, Fedwire and the NYSE all operate requires a federal holiday falling on a SATURDAY (K.8's header rule sends the Reserve Banks to work on the preceding Friday and closes the Board) AND an NYSE that does not close that Friday. Run across K.8's five footnoted Saturday cases, exactly two qualify: 2026-07-03, 2027-06-18 and 2027-12-24 are all full NYSE closures on the exchange's own table, leaving 2027-12-31 (New Year's, which the NYSE explicitly does not observe) and THIS date (Veterans Day, which the NYSE never observes). Columbus Day and Veterans Day are a different and much commoner asymmetry — the NYSE trades and the Board closes every year — but on those the Reserve Banks close too, so the whole Fed is shut rather than only its publishing desk. THIS DATE IS THE CLEANER MEMBER OF THE CLASS and that is why it is worth a row: unlike 2027-12-31 it is not a year-end or quarter-end session, so it isolates the board-only-dark mechanism from the year-end pile-up its sibling carries. NOTHING TRADEABLE IS CLAIMED: symbols is empty and no house playbook is calendar-keyed. TWO GAPS THE PROPOSER COULD NOT CLOSE and is recording rather than smoothing. (1) The bond side is UNVERIFIED — SIFMA recommends a full fixed-income close for Veterans Day, but no source read this session says what it recommends when the holiday falls on a Saturday, and sifma.org was not fetched here; do not assume either an open tape or a closure. (2) The OCC expiration calendar fetched this session stops before 2028, so any expiration coincidence is unchecked. The receiving lane should settle both before writing a stance. IT IS ALSO THE OUT-OF-SAMPLE TEST OF ITS SIBLING'S OWN FINDING: fed-board-closure-2027-12-31 measured, from the Board's release archive by release date, that H.4.1's Thursday slot makes it immune to a Friday Board closure while H.8's Friday slot is not (h8 0-of-4 on board-closure Dec-31 Fridays against 7-of-7 matched controls). 2028-11-10 is a Friday, so the same probe run on it either replicates that or breaks it. Proposed as an estimate; estimate widens caution and licenses no entry.
